changes: Unsafe lateral merges yield before longitudinal collision resolution; manual, assisted and AI requests share the same rule.
Physical lateral clearance is 0.65 m centre-to-centre, converted to horizontal lane offsets using actual track banking. A separate 0.02 m offset margin prevents contact while waiting to merge.
The HUD distinguishes an unsafe merge from an actual longitudinal blockage.
regression_cases: Manual outward and inward cut-in cannot stop the incumbent, for either rider index order.
Simultaneous opposite merges preserve lateral order; closing rear traffic blocks unsafe insertion.
A rider just inside the lateral margin cannot step through the physical collision boundary.
Adjacent lines at 0.70 m on the straight, or 0.52 m horizontal offset with 1.31 banking scale, do not clamp either rider.
Main.gd holds a manual lane request until the gap opens, then completes it. Actual adjacent-line physics at 60 Hz generates no false blockage warning.
Full 4/12/16-rider elimination races complete with correct elimination count and bounded physiology.
limitations: Headless reconstructions of the reported situations, not a replay of the exact screenshot state.
Full elimination simulations use 0.1 s steps; a targeted actual-physics test also runs at 1/60 s.
No physical Zwift Ride/KICKR or new on-track visual playtest.
Existing import cache reused; certificate/UID and Blender configuration warnings remain.
